headline: A Spotify playlist promoted with odd retro-style AI cartoons became an internet joke in October, and an artist says the characters were copied from their fan art.
score_reason: Pure meme culture; events mostly 5-7 Oct, so lowered from 3.
importance_line: It shows AI-made promotional videos winning views and ridicule at once, with an unproven claim that an artist's work was used without permission; it matters little beyond internet culture.
summary: Know Your Meme reports that the 'Losercore Playlist', a Spotify playlist of moody alternative rock with more than 187,000 saves, became a meme after its TikTok promoter switched to retro-styled AI animations that went viral in early October 2026. Users on X mocked the videos as 'AI slop', and on 7 Oct an artist, @antdoe13, accused the creator of generating the characters from their TV Girl fan art, which is an allegation the article does not confirm.
notes: Read in full; main events 5-7 Oct 2026, Know Your Meme guide published 14 Oct.
